subject: Discovery recap — next steps & rotating demo slots
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Julia Barnes <julia.barnes@aurelia-thera.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-09-12T15:20:00-07:00
Subject: Discovery recap — next steps & rotating demo slots

Hi Julia — great conversation today, thanks for walking us through the Aurelia platform priorities. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock in a technical deep dive/demo with your engineering team.

Key notes from today (short):
- Primary goal: reduce inference latency on batch analytics pipelines while keeping model costs under control.
- Data residency: pilot runs will stay in our US cluster; eventual EU region required for PHI-sensitive workflows.
- Security/compliance: Aurelia requested SOC2 and token-level audit samples; Ben will follow up with artifacts.

Proposed next meeting: 60-minute technical deep dive (demo + infra Q&A). To make this inclusive for your US/EU/APAC contributors we suggested using a rotating slot approach so the recurring meeting moves across timebands week-to-week (keeps the on-call engineers aligned without overnights).

Initial rotating-slot options (we can convert to calendar invites if one works):
- Option A (US-friendly week): Tue 10:00–11:00 PT / Wed 18:00–19:00 CET / Thu 02:00–03:00 SGT — Week 1, then rotate
- Option B (EU-friendly week): Wed 14:00–15:00 CET / Wed 05:00–06:00 PT / Thu 21:00–22:00 SGT — Week 2, then rotate
- Option C (APAC-friendly week): Thu 09:00–10:00 SGT / Wed 18:00–19:00 PT / Thu 11:00–12:00 CET — Week 3, then rotate

Ask: can you confirm which of these options gets the most attendance from your engineers? If none of the three fit, tell us two 60-minute windows (with time zone) that work best and we’ll build a 3-week rotating cadence.

Logistics / what we’ll bring to the call:
- Live demo of Redwood inference showing latency/throughput tradeoffs on a sample model (Marissa)
- A short runbook for how rotating slots are configured and automated in our calendar (Ben)
- Security artifacts and SOC2 excerpts (attached, Ben)

Attachments: discovery-notes-aurelia.pdf (short notes), slot-proposal-rotating-v2.ics (proposed 3-week rotation template), security-questions-answers.docx

If it helps I can also send a short Doodle/poll, but I find these three options are easiest to review first.

Thanks — happy to adjust.

Rishi
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
https://www.redwoodinference.com

---

From: Julia Barnes <julia.barnes@aurelia-thera.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Aurelia Technical Team <eng@aurelia-thera.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-09-12T23:04:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Discovery recap — next steps & rotating demo slots

Thanks Rishi — helpful recap and the attachments look good. Quick answers from our side: we can definitely commit to a 60-minute deep dive.

Attendance notes:
- Myself (Engineering Lead) will attend most weeks.
- Please try to hit a slot where Samir (lead infra engineer, CET) and Hyejin (ML engineer, SGT) can join at least bi-weekly.

Preference: Option B (EU-friendly week) gets the strongest immediate coverage from our core team. If we do a 3-week rotation with Option B as Week 1 that would work as long as the APAC slot in the rotation is not earlier than 20:00 SGT.

Can you do Week 1 starting the week of Sep 20? Also: we’ll need the SOC2 excerpt by end of next week for our procurement review — Ben please tag the right doc.

If you can send a calendar sequence (3-week rotating series) I’ll get internal acceptance and share with our corporate calendar.

Cheers,
Julia Barnes
Engineering Lead, Aurelia Therapeutics
julia.barnes@aurelia-thera.com

Thanks Julia — great, we’ll plan to start the rotating series the week of Sep 20 with Option B as Week 1. A few quick operational notes and next actions: 

1) Calendar invite: I created a 3-week rotating series based on the template attached and posted it to the link below. Please accept if the times align for your team. If anyone needs exceptions we can add individual occurrences.
- Calendar preview: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=rotating-slots-proposal

2) APAC constraint acknowledged — we’ll ensure the APAC-facing week does not start earlier than 20:00 SGT.

3) Deliverables before the first demo (target Sep 17):
- Ben: SOC2 excerpt + token-level audit sample (Ben will send by Sep 16)
- Rishi: meeting agenda + sample model details (Rishi will attach to the invite)
- Marissa: demo checklist and infra diagram (will add to the invite notes)

4) Proposed agenda for first deep dive (60m):
- 5m: intros & success criteria
- 25m: live demo — throughput and latency tradeoffs on a sample workload (Marissa)
- 15m: infra / deployment questions (Ben)
- 10m: next steps & pilot scoping (Rishi)

If that looks good I’ll convert the series to full invites and include the ics file. Looking forward to meeting the Aurelia team.

Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com
